summary: GitHub App publication is server-only and installation-scoped. Direct companion clone/publication and PAT paths are retired; companion execution is bounded, approval-gated, and isolated from Internet egress. Browser companion access is a same-origin, allowlisted proxy over the private Compose network.

acceptanceEvidence.repositoryAuth: GET /api/github/repositories derives workspace scope from the URL, requires authenticateServerPrincipal with the server signing secret, accepts no request-body actor, and only honors the platform user header when CONDUCTOR_TRUST_PLATFORM_IDENTITY=true. Focused tests cover signed human identity, unauthenticated rejection, and spoofed-header rejection.
acceptanceEvidence.installationScopedGitHubApp: GitHubAppClient mints an RS256 GitHub App installation token inside the request path; token/private-key values are neither returned nor persisted. Installation repository selection and protected merge use that token only.
acceptanceEvidence.protectedPublication: Publication refuses source=target/default branch, uses a payload-bound short-lived permit, refreshes protection/head/PR/effective checks/statuses/reviews immediately before merge, reconciles a matching already-merged retry only, and never falls back to push.
acceptanceEvidence.pagination: Effective check runs, commit status contexts, PR reviews, and installation repositories use bounded page iteration. Focused tests require successful data on page 2 after 100 incomplete entries on page 1.
acceptanceEvidence.webhookAndAudit: Webhook verification compares X-Hub-Signature-256 against the exact raw request bytes; durable delivery dedupe and raw-byte digest remain in place. Audit payloads exclude permit text, installation tokens, private keys, and provider response bodies.
acceptanceEvidence.retiredCredentialPaths: Both companion services receive no GITHUB_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN, github-token secret, PAT/OAuth injection, askpass credential, or GitHub App secret. App credentials are configured only on web in compose.github.yaml. Legacy /git/clone, /git/action, and /provider/github/* are retired; browser UI/tool adapter no longer expose git.remote, github.create-repository, clone, or PAT creation.
acceptanceEvidence.boundedExecution: The execution plane uses direct execFile with an executable/argument allowlist, rejects shells, env wrappers, absolute executables, aliases, send-pack/push, node -e, and unsafe npm lifecycle scripts. Mutation routes retain payload-bound approval, fresh Contract v2 binding, and single-use approval consumption.
acceptanceEvidence.networkBoundary: Companions attach only to internal:true companion-private. Web attaches to default plus companion-private. The same-origin proxy permits a small fixed route/method set, bounds POST bodies to 4.5 MB, forwards only content-type and X-Conductor-Approval, and rejects unknown and retired publication routes before transport. Tests cover the allowlist, approval-header forwarding, credential-header exclusion, and body limit.
